system.SetTimestepperType(chrono.ChTimestepper.Type_EULER_IMPLICIT_LINEARIZED)

    x = (i / n_elements) * length

# 3. Add constraints

# Apply motor to last node for axial displacement

motor.SetName("Axial Motor")
